question: The archaeological findings in the Mangar Forest consist of all the following except
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Tools.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is** 1) tools.**
 
• The passage states that the archaeological findings in the Mangar Forest consist of **cave paintings, rock art, **and **open-air ceremonial sites. **
 
• However, there is no mention of the discovery of tools in this area.
 
• This can be inferred from the following line in the passage: *"Though tools from the Palaeolithic Age have been identified earlier in parts of the Aravallis, it is for the first time that cave paintings and rock art of a large magnitude have been found in Haryana." (last paragraph)*
 
• This line suggests that while tools have been found in other parts of the Aravalli mountains, they have not been found in the Mangar Forest area where the cave paintings and rock art were discovered.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
